name: v6 / P4b: image-aware hurdle correction (HAC-img) with an open pathology encoder
frozen: 2026-11-10T12:20 local, after the alignment QA (qa.json: inverted 10x matrix, contrast +28.8 grey levels, 100% of cells inside) and before any P4 metric
freeze_instructions: Fill 'frozen' with the date/time BEFORE running dgx/p4_run.py on any slide and after the extract_uni2h.py QA overlay was checked. Do not change anything below after the first P4 metric.
question: Do H&E image features from an independent pathology foundation model add information beyond GHIST+'s own outputs when correcting with measured cores?

image_features.encoder: owkin/phikon (ViT-B/16, pathology-pretrained, open download, Owkin non-commercial licence). UNI2-h is gated (MahmoodLab terms need the user's own account) and is the encoder GHIST+ already uses internally; an independent encoder can add complementary information
image_features.crop: 224 x 224 px at 0.5 um/px (112 um field of view, Phikon's training magnification), centred on each cell; cell um -> Xenium px (/0.2125) -> H&E px via the inverted 10x alignment matrix (chosen by qa: haematoxylin contrast at centroids)
image_features.embedding: [CLS token, mean of patch tokens] = 1,536 dims, float16
image_features.pca: fitted on 50,000 random cells of the slide, seed 0; RNA-free
image_features.compute: Apple M3 GPU (Metal/MPS), fp16, all 564,723 Breast5K cells

methods.HAC-img: HAC whose occurrence ridge also receives the 64 standardised image PCs; magnitude model unchanged; alpha by leave-one-core-out as in HAC

cores_and_evaluation: identical to config_v4.json (headline configs, 3 repeats, 200 um buffer)
slides: breast5k (the only slide with both hurdle outputs and a public H&E); a confirmation slide with hurdle outputs and H&E is not available, so this result is development-slide evidence only
decision_rule: HAC-img adds value if, on each evaluated slide, its headline-config mean median PCC beats HAC with the block-bootstrap CI of (HAC-img - HAC) excluding 0 in >= 2 of 3 repeats, and RMSE is not more than 2% worse. Reported either way.
